mentions.name: withfire.app
mentions.description: AI-powered resume tailoring tool that productizes an automated job-application pipeline. It includes a bookmarklet intake system that parses job postings and adds them to a list, an improve-over-time tailoring loop that identifies skills mentioned in postings but missing from the user's profile and asks about them to refine the profile, and output options that produce polished, human-looking tailored resumes. The author reports it increased their job hear-back rate roughly 5x.
mentions.source_excerpt: The first is withfire.app, which is basically a productization of the AI driven resume tailoring pipeline I used during my last job search.
mentions.author: nameless912
